jobs.title: 2027 Software Dev Engineer Intern - Germany
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Please note the role is available across multiple locations in Germany.  
  
Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?
  
  
At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.
  
  
Our Software Development Engineer (SDE) interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.
  
  
At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE intern, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code - from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.
  
  
We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.
  
  
Amazon internships across all seasons are full-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
  
  
Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well-defined, solvable components before implementation.
  
  
Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed-systems scope varying by team.
  
  
Participate in code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness.
  
  
Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation.
  
  
Use GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output.
  
  
Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.
  
  
Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on-call duties.
  
  
Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.
  
  
A day in the life  
As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead critical projects early in your career.
  
  
In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting.
  
  
About the team  
Intern Community:  
  
As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a vibrant, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.  
  
Support:  
  
The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.  
  
Learning Sessions:  
  
Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's cutting-edge learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.  
  
Opportunities:  
  
Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related STEM fields
* Experience with at least one general-purpose programming language such as Java, Python, C++, C#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript
* Knowledge of computer science fundamentals such as object-oriented design, operating systems, algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience from previous technical internship(s) or demonstrated project experience
* Experience with Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), database systems (SQL and NoSQL), AI tools for development productivity, contributing to open-source projects, and/or version control systems
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
* Strong problem decomposition, problem-solving, and analytical skills
* Demonstrated ownership and initiative in seeing work through from design to operation
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  
  
m/w/d  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: .NET Full Stack Engineer-Consultant/Senior Consultant-AI and Digital Factory
jobs.description:
**SBU - Invent**

**CU - Business Technology**

**Global Grade - B**

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

**YOUR ROLE**
-------------

Our C#/.NET Full Stack Engineers are responsible for creating the visions of our clients and driving better business outcomes. They are tasked with building cutting-edge digital solutions for our clients, combining a clear understanding of business value and a consultative approach to make the difference. They will be able to work on a vast variety of projects and get exposure to a variety of technology such as (but not exhaustively) ASP.NET Core, C#, Entity Framework, SQL Server, RESTful APIs, and microservices architecture.

  

Our Full Stack Engineers sit within Digital Excellence, part of the Business Technology practice in Capgemini Invent, which leads digital transformation projects across Capgemini. We are a new and dynamic community that values innovation, professional development, and the ability to make a real difference for our clients. We work in diverse multi-disciplinary teams, hand-in-glove with our clients.

  

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

  

* Leadership – People/line manager, stakeholder management and communication, recruitment, etc.
* Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
* Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
* Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

  

**YOUR PROFILE**
----------------

* Extensive experience building services using **ASP.NET** **Core** and **C#**
* Experience developing front-end web applications using modern frameworks such as **React, Angular** , or **Blazor/Razor**
* Experience with cloud technologies such as **AWS** or **Azure**
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., **GitLab, GitHub, Jenkins** , or **Azure DevOps** )
* Proficiency with version control systems, primarily Git and familiarity with online repositories ( **GitHub** , **GitLab** , etc.)
* Proven ability to thrive in an agile team environment

**Desirable:**
--------------

* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as **Terraform**
* Experience using **Docker** and **Docker Compose**
* Experience integrating with relational databases (e.g., **SQL Server, Postgres** )
* A strong understanding of web standards, accessibility, and development best practices
* Experience with .NET Entity framework (EF Core)

**Bonus Skills**
----------------

* Experience building microservices using additional languages (e.g., Java or JS/TS)
* Experience integrating with NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB or Cosmos DB)
* Exposure to developing solutions that integrate with LLMs using tools such as Langchain, etc.
* Familiarity with modern design systems and templating engines (e.g., Razor or the GOV.UK Design System)

**WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE?**
----------------------------------------

We are delighted to have received the **“Glassdoor Best Places to work in the UK’ accolade for 4 consecutive years** . To see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page. Capgemini Invent offers Consultants a culture of learning, ownership, and focus on value.

* You’ll gain exposure to high-profile transformations and gain hands-on exposure to leading technologies.
* Our consultants are formally trained by industry experts in consulting and client delivery. Consultants have access to a vast array for different training and certifications in a variety of areas: Cybersecurity (CISSP, CISM), cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), and Agile delivery (Scrum Master, Product Owner, Scaled Agile Framework). Capgemini Invent offers you the flexibility to develop various areas of knowledge in technical domains aligned both to your interests and our client’s outcomes.
* **Les Fontaines** : Capgemini Invent has a unique training environment just outside of Paris, where we can immerse ourselves in thought-leadership, share knowledge and build capabilities that will help us and our clients to succeed.
* We hold monthly showcases of our digital transformation initiatives, sharing knowledge and showing off how the power of technology is impacting our clients.
* There are monthly team drinks, and it’s a chance to connect face-to-face with the wider team over a few drinks in the city. Team away days are always a chance to connect with the team, have fun and learn something new.
* We hold monthly showcases of our digital transformation initiatives, sharing knowledge and showing off how the power of technology is impacting our clients.
* There are monthly team drinks, and it’s a chance to connect face-to-face with the wider team over a few drinks in the city. The monthly team breakfasts give you a different, more relaxed setting to meet up in the office to hear from the leadership, meet colleagues and discuss the trends and insights within the market. Team away days are always a chance to connect with the team, have fun and learn something new.

**NEED TO KNOW**
----------------

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in Diversity & Inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Active Inclusion Campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.
  
  
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
  
  
Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

**We are a Disability Confident Employer**
------------------------------------------

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

* Declare they have a disability, and
* Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

**CSR**
-------

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about. **In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year** . When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have **London** , **Manchester or Glasgow** as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.
  
  
We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

**ABOUT CAPGEMINI**
-------------------

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 350,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**
=============================

**About HSO**
-------------

HSO is a global Business Transformation Partner with deep industry expertise and a long standing strategic relationship with Microsoft. We help organisations unlock the full potential of Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure, Data and AI technologies to modernise operations, accelerate innovation and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

In 2026, HSO achieved Microsoft Frontier Partner status, recognising our advanced capabilities across Microsoft Cloud and AI and our ability to help customers move beyond AI experimentation into secure, governed, enterprise scale production.

With operations across Europe, North America and Asia, we combine industry knowledge, technical excellence and a practical, people first approach to transformation.

As we continue to expand our AI capabilities, we're building a new generation of customer facing engineering talent to help organisations turn the potential of AI and agentic technologies into real, measurable value.

**About the Role**
------------------

HSO is building a new generation of customer facing engineers who will help our customers create the operating model of the future using the latest AI, data and cloud capabilities.

Forward Deployed Engineers combine consulting judgement, production software engineering, data platform expertise, AI delivery capability and business transformation skills.

You will embed with strategic customers, understand their most important business challenges and rapidly turn those challenges into working, production ready AI applications, agentic workflows, automation solutions and data driven platforms.

This is a hands on, outcome led role embedded within customer environments. You'll move quickly from discovery to working software and take accountability for delivering measurable business outcomes.

You'll work across business processes, data platforms, integrations, AI, cloud and security, designing solutions that make effective use of Microsoft technologies while integrating with the customer's wider technology estate.

A strong understanding of modern enterprise data platforms is fundamental to the role. You will need to understand how data is structured, governed, integrated, transformed and made available to AI and application workloads, and how data platform decisions affect the quality, scalability and reliability of the solutions you build.

Forward Deployed Engineers work closely with Deployment Strategists. The Deployment Strategist focuses on identifying where AI can create the greatest customer value and defining the desired outcome. The FDE takes ownership of how that outcome is delivered technically.

From discovery through to go live, both roles work side by side. The FDE owns the technical solution and delivery, while the Deployment Strategist ensures the solution remains aligned to the business problem and measurable value.

The role does not end at first deployment. You'll stay close to solutions through hardening, adoption and handover before moving on to the next value opportunity. You'll also turn what you learn into reusable HSO assets, reference architectures and delivery patterns that help future engagements move faster.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Own Customer Outcomes**

* Embed rapidly within customer teams and develop a strong understanding of their priorities, operating processes, systems, data and constraints.

* Translate ambiguous business problems and defined customer outcomes into clear technical delivery plans.

* Act as the technical lead throughout an engagement, guiding customer sponsors, business users, technical teams and HSO colleagues towards successful delivery.

* Build trusted relationships with senior operational and technical stakeholders, including CTO and CIO level leaders.

* Take ownership for delivering solutions that create measurable customer value rather than simply completing technical tasks.

### **Lead Discovery and Solution Design**

* Lead technical discovery workshops to understand customer challenges and identify high value AI, data and automation opportunities.

* Assess business processes, data readiness, data architecture, integration points, security requirements, technical risks and operational constraints.

* Understand the customer's existing data platform landscape and identify how data needs to be accessed, transformed, governed or modernised to support the required solution.

* Apply a problem first approach to identify the smallest valuable solution that can be built and proven quickly.

* Design end to end solution architectures that balance speed, scalability, maintainability, security and responsible AI.

* Turn discovery into a pragmatic roadmap from prototype through to production.

### **Build and Ship Production Solutions**

* Design, build, integrate, test and deploy enterprise grade solutions using modern cloud, data and AI technologies.

* Develop AI powered applications, copilots, agents, automations, integrations and workflow solutions.

* Build solutions that make effective use of modern enterprise data platforms and ensure AI applications are supported by reliable, governed and accessible data.

* Integrate solutions with platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Services, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow and customer owned systems, APIs and data platforms.

* Apply modern engineering practices including source control, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, observability and secure development.

* Work iteratively. Deliver value quickly, learn from real world usage and progressively harden solutions for enterprise production.

### **Engineer AI and Agentic Solutions**

* Design and implement robust agentic workflows, human in the loop processes and, where appropriate, multi agent architectures.

* Apply modern techniques across retrieval, grounding, orchestration, tool integration, context engineering and evaluation.

* Build evaluation frameworks and guardrails to test AI behaviour, reliability and quality before and after deployment.

* Implement appropriate responsible AI, security, monitoring and governance controls.

* Ensure data quality, lineage, governance and availability are considered as fundamental components of AI solution design.

* Use operational data and user feedback to continuously improve solution quality and performance.

### **Create Reusable HSO Capability**

* Reuse existing HSO assets, accelerators and delivery patterns wherever they improve speed and quality.

* Turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable assets, reference architectures, engineering patterns and playbooks.

* Contribute actively to HSO's AI, Data, Frontier and Horizon engineering communities.

* Share practical knowledge across regions, practices and delivery teams.

* Support and mentor other engineers as the Forward Deployed Engineering capability grows.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

We're looking for experienced engineers who combine strong technical depth with commercial awareness and the ability to operate confidently with customers.

You'll ideally bring:

* Significant experience across software engineering, cloud engineering, data engineering, solution development, technical consulting or enterprise technology delivery, with senior level ownership of complex solutions.

* Strong hands on experience building and operating production grade solutions on at least one major cloud platform.

* Strong understanding and practical experience of modern enterprise data platforms, including data architecture, integration, transformation, governance and the role data plays in enabling AI and application workloads.

* Experience with Microsoft data technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, OneLake or comparable enterprise data platforms would be highly valuable.

* Excellent coding capability in a modern language such as Python, C#, TypeScript, JavaScript or Java, with a track record of producing maintainable, production quality software.

* Practical experience designing, building and deploying AI powered applications using platforms such as Azure AI, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Anthropic or comparable technologies.

* Hands on experience with large language models, prompting, retrieval augmented generation, evaluation and agent orchestration.

* Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, data platforms and modern distributed application architectures.

* Experience with modern engineering and DevOps practices including CI/CD, automated testing, source control and infrastructure as code.

* Strong customer facing experience in consulting, transformation, delivery or technical leadership.

* The ability to work effectively where requirements are incomplete, priorities evolve quickly and the right answer is not immediately obvious.

* The judgement to balance engineering excellence with speed, practicality and customer value.

You do not need to be an expert in every technology we use. More important is the ability to learn quickly, understand unfamiliar environments and apply strong engineering and data fundamentals to new problems.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Certifications across Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, AWS, Google Cloud or leading AI platforms.

* Experience working with enterprise platforms such as Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow or similar.

* Experience implementing responsible AI, AI governance, evaluation frameworks or model monitoring in enterprise environments.

* Experience designing or delivering modern data platforms that support analytics, operational applications or AI workloads.

* Experience across industries such as Manufacturing, Retail, Financial Services, Public Sector or Professional Services.

* A track record of turning successful customer solutions into reusable patterns or accelerators.

* Experience leading small, highly capable engineering teams from discovery through to production.

**Why Join HSO?**
-----------------

AI is changing how organisations operate, but most businesses do not need more demonstrations or isolated pilots. They need people who can identify where AI will genuinely create value, ensure the underlying data foundations are fit for purpose and then build something that works in production.

That is what this role is designed to do.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at HSO, you'll work directly with strategic customers at the point where emerging AI, data and cloud capabilities meet real business problems.

You'll have the opportunity to:

* Build real AI products and solutions rather than proof of concepts that never reach production.

* Work across AI, cloud and data platforms to solve complex customer problems end to end.

* Work directly with senior customer stakeholders and see the impact of what you build.

* Operate at the forefront of Microsoft's evolving AI and Data ecosystem as part of a Microsoft Frontier Partner.

* Work across technologies, industries and business problems rather than being confined to a single product or platform.

* Help shape a new engineering capability within HSO rather than stepping into a narrowly defined existing model.

* Turn successful customer work into reusable technology and approaches that can scale across HSO globally.

You'll join a senior, practical and customer focused team that values ownership, curiosity, engineering quality, speed and measurable impact.

**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------

We offer a competitive base salary alongside HSO's standard employee benefits.

The role will also include a performance related element designed to recognise both individual contribution and the value created through successful customer delivery. Further details on the compensation structure and performance measures will be discussed during the recruitment process.
